title: One-time target:v17 clearing pass over the objectui local backlog (48 queued + defect-class findings)
body:
Action 2 of the maintainer's 2026-08-09 directive (「三个动作都创建issue」); companion to #6903 (producer clause) — see there for the measured gap: objectui local backlog at 117 open / 48 pm:queue with zero open `target:v17`, while the console ships from it.

## Deliverable

One clearing pass over objectui's local open backlog — the 48 `pm:queue` cards plus defect-class findings — mirroring the 2026-08-06 objectstack pass (309 → 46):

- Apply the board's binary criterion to each defect-class card: **"Can the current RC ship without fixing this?"** Blocking classes, unchanged from the SKILL: ① a shipped-surface defect users hit today (wrong data, silent loss, security hole, does not run); ② public contract declared-but-not-enforced; ③ stored-data / migration shape that cannot be fixed post-release; ④ anything the release notes would have to apologize for (including follow-the-docs-and-fail first-hour experience). Improvements, refactors, observations, internal tooling, cosmetic polish stay off the board by default.
- Apply `target:v17` in the objectui repo to the cards that qualify, one line of audit comment each (criterion class + one-sentence rationale).
- This is a **single** stock pass — afterwards both repos are incremental-only, never full-rescan (same posture as objectstack).

## Executor and authority

Executor: the **objectui whole-repo seat** (its local backlog, its new producer duty per #6903). Authority for the pass derives from the maintainer's 2026-08-09 directive directly — this card does not need to wait for #6903's SKILL text to merge; the SKILL amendment records the standing duty, this card clears the stock.

No `domain:*` label applied — routing is the triage seat's single-producer territory.
